text: As at 31 December 2025 the controlling shareholder of Bank of Communications was China's Ministry of Finance, which held 30,942,772,271 A and H shares, 35.02% of the bank, according to the bank's 2025 annual report. The National Council for Social Security Fund, an entity under the management of the Ministry of Finance, held another 13.75%.
short: China's Ministry of Finance is Bank of Communications' controlling shareholder, with 35.02%.

source.name: Bank of Communications Co., Ltd. — Annual Report 2025 (English, H-share edition), Corporate Governance: Controlling Shareholders
source.quote: As at the end of the Reporting Period, the controlling shareholder of the Bank was Ministry of Finance.
source.note: Same section: 'Ministry of Finance held a total of 30,942,772,271 A shares and H shares of the Bank, representing a shareholding of 35.02% of the Bank'; SSF (the National Council for Social Security Fund) is 'the third largest shareholder of the Bank', 'an independent legal entity under the management of Ministry of Finance', holding 13.75%. Listed on the bank's 'Annual Report' investor page, dated 27 April 2026.
